Name: No. 1 Capepaw Road - The Hedge Maze

actions.text: Dozer "A maze. Arthur's hedges. Of course it's a maze."
Who let you in? Hmph. Have you seen my wallet? Brown leather. Irreplaceable.
alternativeTexts: Neighbourhood watch, me. Nothing gets past Arthur. Except my wallet, apparently.

actions.text: My wallet! A bit chewed... Brutus, I suppose.
You've earned this. Spare key for No. 10 - nobody's lived there for years, but something shiny keeps flying in and out.
I'll unlock my front gate too, so you needn't crawl back through that fence.
